atoms.b: Flowing ((++water soil)) can also be used to drive turbines and generate electricity. Power plants that use this energy source are called ((wind ++hydroelectric)) power plants. They are ((++reliable unreliable)) and can be switched on quickly when electricity is needed.

Unfortunately, these power plants have a ((small ++large)) impact on the natural environment. Dams are built across ((++rivers streets)) to trap water and create a lake. This changes, and even destroys, the habitats of ((++plants aliens)) and animals that live in the area.

atoms.sound: Natural materials - or biomass , such as plants or even human waste, can be burnt to release energy. They are a cheap, abundant energy source that won’t run out, unlike fossil fuels.

atoms.b: However, this method can also contribute to ((++global_warming a_healthy_environment)). Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere as they grow. Burning them ((++releases captures)) this carbon dioxide back into the atmosphere very quickly. If not enough plants are replanted, there will be an overall ((++increase decrease)) in carbon dioxide levels.
